items.title: Prime density of isomorphic reduction groups for prime-isogenous elliptic curves with non-CM finite-level evaluation
items.author: John Cullinan; Nathan Kaplan
items.difficulty_reason: The complete density/evaluation result requires more than its formal probability formula: it proves eventual non-CM stabilization via explicit Frobenius matrix classes, discriminant valuations and the ascending/descending structure of ell-isogeny volcanoes, then combines division-field degrees and Chebotarev to reduce the infinite density sum to finite-level data plus a geometric tail. All original prime-isogeny, non-CM/level conditions and separate CM scope retained. Old Bayes support and individual numerical examples are not counted separately or rerun.

primary.label: complete original central density theorem together with its non-CM finite-level stabilization, counted jointly once

proof_spans.label: complete original CM scope, Chebotarev/composite fields, Frobenius/isogeny-volcano stabilization proof, density proof, examples and original CM table

contexts.label: original equal-group density, Tate-level, division-field and conditional-probability definitions
